product.name: Monoprice Motorized TV Ceiling Mount with Remote control for 43 to 86 Displays up to 99lbs Max VESA 800x400
product.description: Monoprice™Motorized TV Ceiling Mount with Remote Control, 43–86" Displays, Up to 99lbs, Max VESA® 800x400, Wi-Fi & App ControlGetting a large-screen TV out of a living room or conference room and overhead requires a mount that does the work automatically, hides the hardware cleanly, and holds the display steady. The Monoprice Motorized TV Ceiling Mount delivers exactly that for displays from 43" to 86" and up to 99lbs. Press a button and the motorized lift drops the screen to viewing position or raises it flat against the ceiling, with tilt angle adjustable from 0° to 80° and two programmable memory positions for one-touch recall of your preferred heights.The mount handles 11 VESA mounting patterns from 200x100 to 800x400, so it works with virtually every large-format consumer and commercial display without adapters. The integrated IEEE 802.11b/g/n Wi-Fi connects to the Tuya Smart app for smartphone control, Amazon Alexa voice commands, and Google Home integration. Hardware for both wood-joist and masonry ceiling installation ships in the box, and the AC adapter accepts 100–240V input for US and international deployment. FCC Part 15 Subpart B Class B compliance and ISED Canada ICES-003 certification mean this mount meets residential interference requirements out of the box.Installation is a two-person job by design; the ceiling plate attaches first, then the motorized assembly locks in and is lowered to full extension via the remote before the TV is mounted to the crossbar. Two bracket height positions accommodate differences in panel depth so the display sits level when retracted. Backed by Monoprice’s 1-year limited warranty and free live technical support at monoprice.com.Motorized lift for flat and pitched ceilings. Raises to flush-ceiling storage or lowers to your chosen tilt angle (0°–80°) at the press of a button — no ladder required after initial setup.Fits displays from 43" to 86". Handles 11 VESA patterns from 200x100 to 800x400 and supports up to 99lbs (45kgs), covering most consumer and commercial flat or curved panels.Three ways to control it. Use the included RMT-02 remote (up to 10m range), the Tuya Smart app on iOS or Android, or Amazon Alexa and Google Home voice commands.Two programmable memory positions. Store two preferred heights or angles in mem1 and mem2 for instant one-touch recall without manual adjustment.Hardware for both ceiling types included. Wood-joist screws and masonry expansion anchors ship in the box; no separate hardware kit required.Low standby draw. Power consumption drops to no greater than 0.5W at idle (no greater than 2W networked standby), satisfying ecodesign requirements for household electronics.Universal AC adapter. Accepts 100–240V at 50–60Hz, compatible with US and international power without a voltage converter.FCC Class B and ISED Canada certified.
